# NEDB Documentation (deep dives)

GitBook-styled official docs for nedb-engine v8.0.0. Generated from tools/build_docs_site.py.

- [Introduction](index.html): What NEDB is, what it guarantees, and a five-minute start.
- [Provenance & Time](provenance.html): The four axes: what, when, true-when, why — and the three commitments.
- [The Query Language — neSQL](nesql.html): PostgreSQL SQL + the extended FROM-form: one grammar, one evaluator, one router.
- [The FROM-form in Depth](nql.html): Full clause reference: predicates, three-valued logic, aggregates, indexes.
- [Wire Protocols](protocols.html): HTTP/JSON, PostgreSQL wire (simple + extended), RESP2.
- [Durability](durability.html): Flush contracts, crash boundaries, the v3 segment store, repair.
- [Replication](replication.html): tip / since / scan_status, state roots, the SSE event stream.
- [Cast — the AI planner](cast.html): A 3.33M-parameter local model that plans queries. Safety by construction.
- [Clients & Adapters](clients.html): Embedded cores, the HTTP client, and the wrap_* audit family.
- [CLI Tools](cli.html): nedb-cli, the nesql CLI, nedb-inspector — operating stores offline.
- [Architecture](architecture.html): The OpLog, the deterministic fold, and three storage generations.
- [Releasing](releasing.html): One tag, three distributions, every version file in lockstep.
